ruleset_status: Dungeon-environment tables validated against Four Against Darkness Expanded Edition (2024). Caverns/fungal grottoes environment routing, heroic/legendary skill tables (45/45 + 20/20 wired), class-trick implementation table (24 wired + 1 planned flavor row), and map-element structural validation (42 tiles) are on the home Rules tables panel; verify row text against owned PDF when available.

door_table.notes: Opened by spellcasting vs door L only. +1 Treasure in tile behind.
Lock-picked or destroyed by Lightning/Fireball; cannot be bashed.
Spend 3 Clues or illusionist spellcasting vs HCL.
Unlocked; opening triggers trap. Rogue may disarm vs trap L.
Opens with 1 Clue or 1 gnome Gadget point.

trap_table.notes: All PCs Save vs poison; barbarians and halflings add +L.
Lead PC Save; light armor -1, heavy -2, halfling/elf +1, rogue +L.
Two random PCs Defense vs HCL+4.
Position 4 Defense vs HCL+4; armor applies, shield does not.

treasure_table.result: Roll on the Dungeon Magic Treasure Table.

hidden_treasure_table.result: An alarm goes off, attracting Wandering Monsters!
The loot is protected by a trap.
hidden_treasure_table.notes: Rogue disarm Save vs HCL+1; otherwise random PC Save vs HCL+1 (2 Life on natural 1).

hidden_treasure_table.result: The treasure is protected by a ghost.
hidden_treasure_table.notes: Cleric ban Save vs HCL or all PCs lose 1 Life.

search_table.notes: Corridors Search at -1; a 0 counts as Wandering Monsters.
Choose hidden treasure, secret door, secret passage, or 1 Clue held by a selected character.

any.description: Treasure is protected by a trap.

corridor.description: The corridor is empty and may be searched.
The corridor is empty and may be searched.

room.description: The room contains a special feature.

corridor.description: The corridor is empty and may be searched.
The corridor is empty and may be searched.

room.description: The room is empty and may be searched; alternatively, spend 2 Clues to find a Secret Passage.
This chamber is a dragon's lair.

wandering_monsters_table.result: Roll on the Weird Monsters Table.
Roll on the Boss Monsters Table.
wandering_monsters_table.notes: Reroll dragons and Foes never encountered as Wandering Monsters.

dungeon_special_events_table.result: A ghost passes through the party.
A Lady in White offers a Quest.
A wandering healer offers healing for 10gp per Life.
A wandering alchemist sells potions and poison.
dungeon_special_events_table.notes: If already met this adventure, roll on the Traps Table instead.

dungeon_special_features_table.result: Fountain/Pool: living PCs recover 1 Life the first time in an adventure.
Blessed Temple/Shrine: one PC gains +1 Attack vs undead or demons until one is slain.
Armory: PCs may change weapons within class limits.
Cursed Altar: a random PC is cursed (-1 Defense).
Statue: leave alone or touch (d6: 1-3 living statue, 4-6 breaks for gold).
Puzzle box: Save vs d6 L or take 1 damage per failed attempt.

minion_reaction_table.result: The minions try to take captives! Their attacks are non-lethal. This p.102 roll-1 rule overlays named Minion bestiary tables as well as the generic Minion table.

major_reaction_table.result: The foe demands a large bribe.
The foe fights to the death!

basic_spells_table.result: Removes curse or petrification from one ally (combat or exploration).
Teleports the caster to the first tile of the adventure. Works automatically; may be cast during combat or exploration instead of a Defense roll.
Lightning bolt vs. one foe: spell total must meet foe Level; slays 1 vermin/minion on hit, or 2 Life damage to a boss/weird foe. Some elementals are immune.
Area vs minions: on hit, slays max(1, spell total − minion Level) vermin/minions. Single boss/weird: 1 Life damage on hit (cannot also wipe minions). Dragons immune. Mummies +2 on the roll.
+1 Defense for one ally until combat ends.
Spellcasting roll vs. one foe; on hit, defeats one boss/weird or knocks out d6+L vermin/minions. No effect on undead, dragons, artificial/construct/elemental/spirit foes, or foes L11+.
Cleric prayer: restore d6+L Life to one ally. Three uses per adventure; stays on the spell list when expended.

druid_spells_table.result: Melee-style spellcasting vs vermin with +2×L; disperses (no loot) rather than slaying.
Summons a L3 beast ally (5 Life, 1 damage/turn) for the encounter.
Spellcasting roll; on hit: 2 dmg to fire foes, disperse 2 vermin, KO 1 minion, or let party flee.
Transform into a bear (warrior L, 8 Life) until combat ends; half bear damage applies after.
Destroys wooden doors/objects or inflicts 2 damage to plant/wood foes.
+2 Defense until combat ends; -2 on agility Saves and vs fire.
Like Lightning but outdoors only (not in dungeons).
Auto-entangles one major or d6 minor foes (-1 effective L this encounter).
Like Spiderweb but only outdoors in forest/swamp/jungle.
All allies ignore the -1 subdual attack penalty until combat ends.
Woodland travel ignores vegetation for 10×L minutes (outdoors only).
Outdoor weather control; +1 to druid Lightning Strike, douses fires, etc.

illusionist_spells_table.result: +L Defense until combat ends (no bonus vs vermin/undead/artificial/elemental).
Creates L+1 images (1 Life each) that absorb one hit each.
Summons a servant to carry treasure (200gp, weapons, armor) until slain or trapped.
Dispels illusions/invisibility; invisible foes become visible at reduced L.
Spellcasting roll holds a foe for L turns (+2 to hit; subdual damage).
Mist suspends ranged/gaze attacks; +2 Defense when fleeing.
Disguise for L hours; reroll Reaction or social Save.
Subdual damage equal to spellcasting roll on hit.
Foes must pass Morale or cannot attack the illusionist this encounter.
Successful roll counts as an immediate successful Bribe Reaction.
Creates L+3 illusionary food rations (max 7 days sustenance).
Flaming sword +L Attack for L+3 turns; all damage is subdual.

scrolls_table.result: Spend 1 turn to read and cast the scroll spell; the scroll is destroyed.
Any PC except barbarians may burn a scroll.
Barbarians may not use magic items, scrolls, or potions; they may carry them for allies.
Non-casters add +1 to the spellcasting roll; casters add +L even if the spell is not memorized.
Wizards may copy a new spell into their spellbook instead of casting (destroys scroll).
Wizard spells on parchment; illusionist spells on prisms; druid spells on bark.

experience_classical_table.result: Earn 1 XP roll after 10 minor-foe encounters (vermin/minions; foe count per fight does not matter).
Earn 1 XP roll for each Secret revealed (3 Clues).
Earn 1 XP roll for each Major Foe defeated (weird or boss).
Earn 1 additional XP roll for the dungeon Final Boss; room major foes can be revealed by a scout, which rolls the Final Boss check immediately.

Spend an XP roll to advance. Basic heroes roll d6 > Level (6 always succeeds). Expert-trained heroes roll d8+2 and may choose Level up or Learn expert skill/spell. Expert tier entry is a separate 500gp or 1 banked-XP training cost.

economy_services_table.result: Restore 1 Life to one hero while the healer is on the current tile.
Potion of Healing added to one hero inventory (once per hero per adventure).
Blade poison added to one hero inventory (once per hero per adventure).

experience_slow_sure_table.result: At the end of a successful adventure, one surviving PC gains 1 Level (no XP rolls during play).

experience_old_school_table.result: Add defeated foe levels to XP tally (vermin: half levels, rounded down).
Add 1 XP per gp claimed (resale value for magic items).
Spend (Tier+2)×100 XP to gain 1 Level (same PC cannot level twice in a row unless sole survivor).

experience_slower_table.result: Earn XP like Classical, but bank points instead of immediate rolls.

Spend XP equal to target Level to attempt advancement; +1 per extra XP spent. Expert-trained heroes use Expert dice and may learn expert skills instead of leveling. Expert tier entry is paid separately through Tier training.

quest_table.result: Bring me its head! Slay a Boss and return to the Quest-giver.
Bring me Gold! Deliver d6×50gp treasure to the Quest-giver's tile.
I want it alive! Subdue a Boss and bring it to the Quest-giver.
Bring me that! Find the quest item on a Major Foe (1-in-6 per kill).
Let peace be your way! Complete 3 non-violent encounters (bribe, peaceful reaction, Sleep).
Slay all the Foes! Defeat the Final Boss and clear all foes from the dungeon.

epic_rewards_table.reward: The Book of Skalitos (six wizard spell scrolls). Resale 650gp if unused.
The Gold of Kerrak Dar: spend 1 Clue on Search to find 500gp.
One party weapon is enchanted until adventure end (roll 2d6 attack, keep best).
Shield of Warning (permanent magic shield). Resale 200gp.
Arrow of Slaying (auto 3 damage vs one Major Foe type). Resale 3d6×15gp if unused.
Holy symbol of healing (+2 Life from Healing prayer). Resale 700gp.

combat_notes: Attack: exploding d6 + modifiers; total >= foe L to hit (p.91-92).
Defense: exploding d6 + modifiers; total > foe L to avoid 1 damage; natural 1 always fails (p.96).
Light armor +1, heavy armor +2, shield +1; rogues add +L to Defense (p.96).
Minor foes: slain count = attack total // foe L (p.94).
Major foes: damage = multiples over L; L drops by 1 below half Life (p.94).
Morale: minor group at half or less rolls d6; 1-3 flee (p.94).
Poisonous foes: after a hit, Save vs poison or take 1 extra damage (p.96).
Blade poison: +1 damage on next successful melee hit, then consumed (p.165).
Magic resistance (p.97): spell connect vs base L, then penetrate vs L+MR (+1 magic_resist, +1 caster, +1 dragon).
Subdual damage: optional; damage is normal but 0 Life means knocked out, not slain (p.99).
Bribes: pay gp and/or surrender weapons per foe; category tables are fallback when mixed foes appear.
Missile combat: opening volley in rooms (once per hero); rear rank (3-4) may shoot every round in corridors (p.90-91).
Weapon modifiers: two-handed melee +1, light weapons -1, crushing +1 vs skeletons, unarmed -2 (p.93).

combat_modifiers_table.result: Alchemist blade poison: +1 damage on the next successful melee hit, then removed from inventory.
Poisonous foe: after dealing damage, target Save vs poison (barbarian/halfling +L) or take 1 extra damage.
Magic resistance: connect vs base L, then penetrate vs L+MR tiers (magic_resist +1, caster +1, dragon +1).
Each prepared spell/prayer may be cast once per adventure (Healing prayer: 3 uses). Expended spells stay on the sheet but cannot be recast until the dungeon ends.
Subdual attacks deal normal damage; at 0 Life the foe is subdued (not slain). Required for bring-alive Boss quests.
Bribe results may demand gp or weapons per foe (e.g. Goblins: 5gp or 1 weapon each). Mixed payment is allowed.
Rooms: one opening missile shot per hero before close combat (even if foes strike first). Corridors: rear rank (3-4) may use bow/sling each round over the front rank's heads.

Two-handed melee weapons +1 Attack; light weapons (dagger, sling, scimitar) -1; crushing weapons +1 vs skeletons/undead; clerics use full Level Attack vs undead; Blessed Temple/Shrine grants +1 Attack vs undead/demons until one is slain; unarmed -2.

Fallen heroes may be looted in combat (forfeit attack), carried out (carrier: rearguard, no Defense), left outside at entrance, resurrected for 1000gp (d6 ≤ Level; L6+ automatic; full Life), or laid to rest as permanently lost.

Each hero carries at most 200gp in the dungeon; treasure shares from capped heroes redistribute to living heroes with capacity. Excess roster gold stays as home bank gold outside. Starting class weapons and shields do not encumber; extra gear beyond that baseline applies −1 Defense and Saves. Up to 3 extra weapon slots (two-handed = 2) and 2 shields total may be carried.
Roster gold is treated as home bank gold outside the dungeon. While camped outside, living heroes may deposit carried gold or withdraw banked gold up to the 200gp dungeon carry cap.

While camped outside for recovery, or from a saved session, Regroup Party may swap one or more heroes and set marching order before re-entering. Fallen bodies, gear, explored map state, and tile state remain in the dungeon.

Trolls regain 1 Life after each foe melee phase unless wounded by fire, acid, lightning, or oil since the last tick. Fireball, Lightning/Lightning Strike, acid vials, and ignited lantern oil suppress regen (foe card: Regen blocked).

Lantern oil (8gp shop / caverns loot): combat splash vs regenerating foes, 1 Life, blocks regen. Acid vial (30gp shop): combat throw, acid damage, blocks regen. Rare mushrooms (fungal grottoes p.159): Eat in exploration from party sheet.
Note default melee and missile weapons on the hero sheet; wield default at encounter start. Swap melee weapon in combat costs 1 turn (p.94).

caverns_trap_table.result: A stalactite falls! A random PC must Save vs. HCL+2 Trap or lose 1 Life.
caverns_trap_table.notes: All PCs Save at +1/2 L. Rogues add +L. Halflings add +1/2 and may reroll a failed Save.

caverns_trap_table.result: Rockslide. All PCs must Save vs. HCL+2 Trap or lose 1 Life.
caverns_trap_table.notes: All PCs Save at +1/2 L. Rogues, gnomes and dwarves add +L. Halflings add +1/2 and may reroll a failed Save.

caverns_trap_table.result: Hidden Pit. The first PC in Marching Order must Save vs. HCL+1 Trap or fall into a pit, losing 1 Life.
caverns_trap_table.notes: Spend 1 Clue at the bottom to find a Secret Passage to the dungeon or fungal grottoes.

caverns_trap_table.result: Swinging Log Trap. PCs Save in Marching Order vs. an HCL Trap until one fails and loses 2 Life, or all save.
A random PC steps on mushrooms, releasing toxic spores. Save vs. HCL+1 poison or suffer -1 on all Saves for 6 rooms.
caverns_trap_table.notes: Mushroom monks are immune. If a mushroom PC leads the Marching Order, ignore this Trap.

caverns_trap_table.result: Rolling Boulder. Choose front or back; 1d3 PCs in Marching Order must Save vs. HCL+1 Trap or lose 2 Life each. The boulder then blocks one opening on the tile.

fungal_grottoes_trap_table.result: Sleep spores. A random PC must Save vs. HCL Trap or release spores that put to sleep all PCs who fail a Save vs. HCL poison.
fungal_grottoes_trap_table.notes: Mushroom, artificial, undead, elemental PCs are immune. If all PCs fall asleep, the whole party dies.

fungal_grottoes_trap_table.result: Spore Cloud. A random PC must Save vs. HCL+1 Trap or step on a purple puffball; on failure Save vs. HCL+3 poison or lose 1 Life and trigger a 1-in-6 Wandering Monsters chance.
Slime Patch. The PC leading the Marching Order must Save vs. HCL Trap or fall down. Roll a 1-in-6 chance of Wandering Monsters; if they come, the fallen PC skips 1 turn.
Mycelium Snare. A random PC must Save vs. HCL+3 Trap. On failure, an object in their hands is snatched away forever.
Shrieking Mushroom. The lead PC has a 4-in-6 chance of disturbing a mushroom that causes Wandering Monsters to arrive.
fungal_grottoes_trap_table.notes: Reduce the chance by 2 if the PC is a halfling or forester and by 1 if it is a rogue.

fungal_grottoes_trap_table.result: Cordyceps Trap. A random PC must Save vs. HCL+3 poison or attack the ally with the fewest current Life points. The effect wears off after 6 turns or if Blessing or Healing are used.
fungal_grottoes_trap_table.notes: An ally killed by the infected PC rises as an undead Boss Monster.

caverns_special_events_table.result: Trap. Roll on the Cavern Trap Table.

You encounter d6 cavemen explorers looking for food. Give them 2 Food rations (for the whole group) or fight them. They are HCL+3 Minions armed with clubs, standard Morale, 1 Life, 1 attack per turn, no Treasure.

You encounter a morlock Spy. If you pay 5gp, the Morlock betrays his companions. After speaking with him, you cannot be surprised by any morlocks, even those encountered as Wandering Monsters, until you leave the caverns. If you don’t pay, he runs away grumbling insults.

You encounter a cave goblin scout. If you pay 10gp, he warns you of danger. Your PCs cannot be surprised by any Foe, including Wandering Monsters, and have a +1 to all Saves until you exit the caverns. If you do not pay, the goblin shrugs and walks away.

You meet a dwarf miner. You may sell any gems found or buy up to d6 gems worth 25gp each. If you make any trade with the dwarf, the dwarf will reveal the contents of the next tile before you decide whether or not to enter.
If you have a dwarf in the party, you find a gem worth d6x10gp. To collect it, however, you must risk a 1-in-6 chance of Wandering Monsters. If there’s no dwarf, ignore this event.

fungal_grottoes_special_events_table.result: Trap. Roll on the Fungal Grottoes Trap Table and then on the Fungal Grottoes Rare Item Table.

You encounter d6+2 cavemen looking for mushrooms. Give them 4 Food rations or 1 rare mushroom or fight them. They are HCL+3 Minions armed with clubs, standard Morale, 1 Life, 1 attack per turn, no Treasure. If you feed them, they will show you a secret passage (in next tile) leading from the fungal grottoes to the caves.
Spore cloud. All living PCs, except mushroom monks, must Save vs. HCL poison or lose 2 Life. Halflings and barbarians add +L to this Save.

You encounter a halfling scout. If you pay 10gp, he warns you of danger. The PCs cannot be surprised by any Foe, including Wandering Monsters, and will have a +1 to all Saves until they exit the fungal grottoes. If you do not pay, the halfling bids you farewell and walks away.

You meet a merchant. You can buy any item from the Equipment list, but all prices are 20% higher (round up). You can also sell gems or rare mushroom for their full resale value in gp. This event is unique. If you roll it again during the same adventure, count as 4, above.

If you have a mushroom monk in the party, you sense danger approaching through the mycelial network. You may automatically ignore the next Trap or Wandering Monsters encounter in the fungal grottoes. If you do not have a mushroom monk, ignore this event. The warning has no effect in other environments.

caverns_special_item_table.result: Glittering Crystal. This gem glows like a lantern and can be worn around a PC’s neck with a leather string, freeing the use of one hand. Resale value: 25gp.
Map Fragment. At any time, you may use it to roll the contents of the next tile before entering it. One use. Worth 30gp for Bribe Reactions while in the Caverns.

Adventurer’s Dead Body. In addition to a pouch with d6 gems worth 10gp each, you find 1 item of your choice: Heavy Armor, Lantern, 2-handed Weapon, Bow, Crossbow, Scroll with Blessing, Scroll with a random spell, or Jar of chicken blood.
Miners’ Ointment. Use once to ignore Wandering Monsters or avoid invisible gremlins. Not magic. Resale value: 20gp if unused.
Miners’ Amulet. When worn by a PC in position 1, ignore 1 Trap within the caverns. One use per adventure. Resale value: 30gp.

fungal_grottoes_rare_item_table.result: Choose: 1 small gemstone (2d6+2gp) or 1 suit of leafsteel armor (+2 Defense, counts as Light armor, non-magical; discard after 3 adventures).
Red Death. Throw at a living Foe to automatically inflict 1 damage or reduce the Foe’s L by 1 (choose when found). No effect on unliving foes. Requires 1 turn.
Xicthul’s Cap. Throw to inflict d3 automatic damage on a Foe. Requires 1 turn. The user takes 1 damage when thrown. Resale value: 60gp.

Adventurer’s Dead Body. In addition to a backpack with 1 rope, 2d6 Food rations and 2d6gp, you find 1 item of your choice: Heavy Armor, Lantern, 2-handed Weapon, Bow, Crossbow, Scroll with Blessing, or Scroll with a random spell.

Mushroom Gatherer’s Basket. You find d6 white angel mushrooms. Each can be eaten as a Food ration, causing the PC to heal 2 Life. They lose healing power at adventure end and can then be sold for 10gp each.
Morel Crusher. Single use. Cause a Morale roll at -1 in a Foe. Foes who never Test Morale, Foes who fight to the death, unliving Foes, and poison-immune Foes are unaffected. Resale value: 40gp.

fungal_grottoes_rare_mushroom_table.result: Healing mushroom restores 1 Life (Eat on party sheet, exploration).
Strength mushroom (+1 Attack next fight; Eat on party sheet).
Clarity mushroom (+1 next spell roll; Eat on party sheet).
Poison mushroom grants blade poison (Eat on party sheet).
Madness mushroom — Fear Save vs L3 (Eat on party sheet).
Golden mushroom worth 3d6×10gp (Eat on party sheet).

clue_spends_table.result: Spend 3 held Clues deliberately to reveal a Secret. Clues are held by individual characters; choose the PC who discovers it, then the spend drains held Clues from that hero first and other holders if needed. The discoverer gains the campaign-mode Secret reward and chooses one Secret from the p.123 list. Future-use Secrets show timing prompts on sheets plus encounter/combat reminders when relevant.

On a Trade Information reaction, gain 25gp per held Clue without losing those Clues, and/or buy 1 Clue for 100gp. Bought Clues are assigned to an individual character and persist on that roster entry.
Spend 3 held Clues to open an illusion door without an illusionist spellcasting roll. The spend drains individual holders and updates the party total.
Spend 1 held Clue from an individual holder to operate a lever door mechanism.

Spend 3 held Clues for eligible spell learning where the class rules allow it. Prefer the learner's held Clues first, then other holders if needed. Wizard/elf expert spells use the existing expert spell catalog; Expert-trained L5+ druids use the druid spell table.

Spend 3 held Clues any time a hero is held captive by foes to locate the captive's hideout (Someone Has Been Imprisoned secret). A new lair (2d6×2d6 cave) is generated adjacent to the tile where Clues are spent, guarded by the same foe type at double their normal count. Captives are found there with d3 Life. Pay Level×10gp ransom instead of fighting if the foes' reaction allows.
Some quests/special discoveries may spend Clues directly, such as Kerrak Dar-style hoards.

secrets_table.timing: Declare when the chosen Major Foe is met.
secrets_table.result: Use Secret action targets one living Major Foe from the hero sheet or foe chip/menu; party Attack rolls against that foe get +2 for this combat.

secrets_table.timing: Declare when the foe is encountered.
secrets_table.result: Use Secret action ends an eligible non-vermin, non-Final-Boss encounter peacefully; no treasure or XP is gained.

secrets_table.timing: Apply in an empty non-entrance room.
Apply after entering a non-entrance room.
secrets_table.result: Roll magic treasure for the current environment, resolve generic magic weapons immediately, and add the result as claimable room treasure.

secrets_table.secret: True Name of a Spiritual Entity
secrets_table.timing: Choose angel or demon when used.
secrets_table.result: One angelic rescue/heal or demonic damage/kill effect.

secrets_table.timing: Spellcaster only; choose spell when applying.
secrets_table.result: Add a spell from any list/table and gain one temporary slot for it.

secrets_table.secret: Increase of Magical or Spiritual Power
secrets_table.timing: Cleric or spellcaster only; choose spell/prayer when applying.
secrets_table.result: Gain one permanent use of a specific spell or prayer.
Find a basic spell scroll; it is added to the discoverer's inventory if possible, otherwise left as claimable treasure. Existing Burn Scroll and wizard Copy Scroll actions handle use.

secrets_table.timing: Requires 2 defeated Major Foes and 50gp components.
secrets_table.result: Unlock a healing potion purchase option before each adventure.

secrets_table.timing: Declare when eligible foes test morale.
secrets_table.result: Use Secret action declares the effect; the next eligible vermin/minion morale test in this combat fails. Encounter/combat reminders call out the timing when an eligible group is present.

secrets_table.secret: Someone Will Pay Big Money for That
secrets_table.timing: Apply after carrying a valuable item out.
secrets_table.result: One jewel, gem, or jewelry item sells for triple value.

secrets_table.secret: Your Enemy Is in the Dungeon
secrets_table.timing: Declare when a Major Foe is met.
secrets_table.result: Choose a living Major Foe from the hero sheet or foe chip/menu, swap that foe for a chaos lord, and fight it at +1 Attack.

secrets_table.timing: Declare in a room guarded by Minions or a Boss.
secrets_table.result: Rescue an important NPC for a magic item plus treasure, or doubled current gp.

secrets_table.timing: Barbarian or dwarf only; persistent character trait.
Pay food costs while camped outside before re-entering the adventure.
secrets_table.result: Use Secret action consumes 1 Food ration and gives the hero +1 current/max Life for this adventure; roster persistence strips the temporary bonus.

secrets_table.timing: Spend 3 Clues any time a hero is held captive by foes.
secrets_table.result: Spend 3 Clues to locate the captive's hideout. The lair (2d6×2d6 cave) is generated adjacent to the tile where Clues are spent; guarded by the same foe type at double their normal count. Captives are found with d3 Life, stripped of equipment. Pay Level×10 gp ransom instead of fighting if the foes' reaction allows.
